research_basis.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
research_basis.use: Momentum, liquidity and volatility remain dominant stock-native predictors, supporting a core-first architecture.

research_basis.title: The Inefficient Pricing of News
research_basis.use: News is partly predictable from stock characteristics; the external signal must be residualized before it is allowed to adjust the core score.

sign_contract.reason: This makes the frozen subtraction formula directionally explicit.

formula.core_standardization: Fit mean and standard deviation on the training window only, then apply unchanged to the later decision window.
formula.residual_standardization: Fit residual mean and standard deviation on the past-only residual training window only.
formula.cap_governance: The 0.30 cap is frozen before any external return result is observed. Sensitivity may report 0.15 and 0.50, but cannot replace the primary cap after results.
formula.missing_external_data: Use lambda=0 for the affected channel and record an explicit missingness reason.

forbidden_effect: increase gross exposure above the stock-only baseline

sector_state.allowed_effect: adjust ranking only among stocks inside the same PIT sector

individual_event.allowed_effect: bounded incremental score adjustment for a core-eligible stock
forbidden_effect: trigger a buy without the core signal
individual_event.risk_gate: A PIT-valid major negative official event may block an otherwise eligible stock.

residualization.target: raw external channel signal available at the decision cutoff
residualization.predictors: stock-native PIT features only, including momentum, liquidity, volatility, valuation and existing core context
residualization.fit_rule: prediction_model_fit_end must be strictly earlier than decision_cutoff

model_selection.primary_oos_metric: predeclared risk-adjusted stock-only-relative objective under identical account and cost contracts
model_selection.rule: Find the best gate-passing OOS mean, calculate best_mean - best_standard_error, then select the smallest lambda whose OOS mean is at or above that lower bound.

current_gate.reason: No layer currently has two independent providers passing the documentary, timestamp, sample and offline replay gates.
